title: Nvidia is abandoning China after Jensen Huang's ouster | TechCrunch
summary: Nvidia will no longer sell its H200 chips in China, acting CEO Colette Kress said Tuesday, ending the company’s participation in a controversial loophole in the U.S. ban on the sale of advanced chips to the country.
